description: Converts any video ffmpeg on this machine can read (AVI, WMV, FLV, MPEG, H.266/VVC with ffmpeg 7+…) to MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, MPEG-TS or AVI, or extracts the sound to MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV. Picks the video codec (H.264, H.265, AV1, VP9, VP8) and audio codec, or copies the streams with no re-encode (videoCodec/audioCodec "copy", e.g. MKV to MP4). Can shrink to a maximum height (aspect kept, never enlarged), cap the frame rate, trim to a start/end and drop the sound. Needs ffmpeg installed.

audioCodec.description: Default: the format's first (aac, opus for webm/ogg, mp3, pcm); "copy" keeps it

format.description: Default: from the output extension, else mp4

output.description: Default: <name>.<format> next to the input (<name>-converted.<format> for the same extension)

videoCodec.description: Default: h264, or vp9 for webm; "copy" keeps the original stream

name: video_convert
title: Convert and compress video
